title: 1890s Main Street looking north. John T G Carr's house on right
description: 2.    This photograph of Hartland, taken between 1891 and 1895, looks north along the street. The first building on the left is the C. Humphrey Taylor Store, followed by John Barnett’s residence. The third building is the Keith & Plummer General Store, established before 1897, and the fourth is John T. G. Carr’s first store, opened in 1884. The eighth building in the row was the Burtt Store & Hall, while the ninth housed the Matheson Blacksmith Shop and Hall. On the right side, the large home belonged to John T. G. Carr, which later became the Day & Ross Headquarters. The fenced area eventually became the site of the C. Humphrey Taylor Block, and the partially visible home on the right belonged to George Boyer. Built in 1860, Boyer’s home was Hartland’s first post office and drug store.
